key_insight: The best memory budget depends on the agent model: strong models can benefit from full guideline sets, while weaker models may perform better with a small selected subset.
engineering_relevance: Tune memory volume per model and validate end-to-end behavior rather than assuming more stored guidance improves reliability.
method: Mine 1–3 procedural lessons from each agent episode.
Consolidate lessons into guidelines that record how many lessons they merge.
Provide all guidelines or a selected subset at inference.
evidence_signal: On AppWorld, DeepSeek-V3.2 gained 9.5 percentage points in task completion with all 191 guidelines; gpt-oss-120b rose from 39.9% to 51.2% with all 199, versus 55.4% with about 29 selected guidelines, averaged over two runs.
watch_item: Audit guideline provenance, API failures, and evaluation baselines: the authors report lost provenance, a backfiring high-support guideline, and a swallowed API error that failed every task despite plausible logs.
paper_title: How Much Should an Agent Remember? Deployment Lessons from Self-Distilled Memory for LLM Agents
